supportAnchorPolicy.reason: All 16 drawings were separately inspected at the feet. Each has a visible lower supporting foot; no unmistakable airborne frame is present. There is no drawn ground line, so y registration is an explicit visual interpretation. X uses the nominal column center and never follows a lifted leg or body width. Y removes atlas row packing drift while retaining bent-leg body-height changes. Source masks, common canvas and 1:1 pixels remain unchanged. Do not apply to another source hash.

limitations: 本報告僅涵蓋本輪正裝v5與新跑步候選，獨立於舊172格及44格報告；美術均未批准。
三項數字是姿勢／表情代理，不是完整頭部、裸軀幹或骨架模型。
正裝真腳填色基線與強輪廓落位基線分開，必須使用eyeToFootPoints；跑步全部眼足距留空。
遮擋、閉眼、側身或不可靠追蹤保持null，不借用舊圖座標或全人物外框。
只讀原PNG；每段沿用一個目錄scale。量測不會自動改倍率或批准美術。
